how to write by hand
like it's 1900

1. slow down

elegance is never rushed.

2. keep one slant

every letter leaning
the same way.

3. make tall letters taller

l, h, k and d reaching
above the rest.

4. join your letters

a light, flowing
cursive.

5. use a good pen

a fountain pen changes
everything.

6. copy something beautiful

one page of a poem or a
story every day.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. copy something beautiful

i copy one line from the lesson
i read each morning on
an app like Sophia.
